resources.string: Words marked with * are not in the dictionary.

Offline machine translation between Sardinian and Italian, built on the free Apertium translator and its apertium-srd-ita language pair.

Sardinian is written in Limba Sarda Comuna (LSC), the orthographic standard of the Autonomous Region of Sardinia. When translating from Sardinian, use standard spelling.

Words marked with * are not in the dictionary.

Free software, GNU GPL v3: github.com/rmtheis/translate (sardu folder). Version %1$s.
